options.text: Recency decay factor $\lambda$ was too aggressive, reducing the recency component to zero.
add_memory() appends every turn to an unbounded list with no cap or eviction policy, so the store grows for the entire session lifetime.
retrieve() ignores its own query argument and returns the entire memory list unranked, so relevant memories are buried among irrelevant ones.
Memories are stored keyed by conversation turn number instead of by content hash, so two memories from the same turn silently overwrite each other.
